import re,html,json,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path('products/research/computational-prize-test')
out={}
for n in ['hutter-rules.html','azspcs-home.html','topcoder-challenges.html']:
    t=(d/'raw'/n).read_text(errors='replace')
    t=re.sub(r'(?is)<(script|style).*?</\1>',' ',t)
    t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t))
    t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t)
    out[n]={'len':len(t),'text':t[:9000]}
(d/'extract.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=1))
print(json.dumps(out)[:100])
